CSCA Prep offers free timed practice in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. Choose an available mock, review its question count and duration, and sign in to start. Practice questions and explanations are independent preparation material, not official CSCA exam papers.

What the platform provides

Timed exam attempts with answer saving and submission.

Marks for the questions in the selected mock.

Question review and worked explanations after submission.

Topic practice and spaced-repetition review to support follow-up study.

Official Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry papers contain 48 questions in 60 minutes. Platform exams can be configured differently, so the instructions shown before starting your chosen mock determine its count and duration. Professional Chinese practice is not part of this platform’s current subject offering.

Start a mock

Create an account or sign in.

Open the exam list in the student portal.

Select an available exam and check its subjects, question count and time limit.

Answer under the displayed conditions and submit when finished.

Review mistakes and return to topic practice before another fresh set.

Interpret the result

A mark is feedback on that practice set. For example, 36 correct answers out of 48 is 75% correct. This is not an official score conversion, an estimate of national rank or a prediction of your real exam result.

A high practice mark may reflect familiar questions. Use new sets where available, and check whether you can explain the method without seeing the solution. Read scoring and requirements before using a practice result to plan an application.

Original worked example

For x² − 5x + 6 = 0, factor to obtain (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0. The roots are 2 and 3. Substituting them into the original equation checks the answer. This example illustrates solution review; it is not an official CSCA question.

Share questions safely

Your student attempt history requires your account. Do not assume a review link is public, and do not share login details. When asking for help, share the question and your reasoning while keeping personal account information private.

Sources and scope

CSCA official portal — current sitting notices, registration, candidate instructions and results.

Shanghai government CSCA guide — subject format and the role of CSCA in undergraduate applications.

Campus China — Chinese Government Scholarship information. Use the receiving university’s current program notice for admission and funding requirements.

This is independent preparation guidance. Requirements can differ by university, program, scholarship and intake. Follow the official notice that applies to your application.
